pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Soil**.

Claim the pad. Wood, dirt, a bench, a sapling, a chest, warmth. Melt ice with lava for water on Normal and Hard. Cook something.

Finish the **Soil Knot**. It hands you the Soil token. Raise a Tension Post and **seat** it. The pad starts mending you. Until that token is seated, Wake is not done.

pages.title: Wake
pages.text: The Pad-keepers kept hearths, not fires — the warmth in thin dirt. Wake is that work: make the pad hold you.
